title: Join Six Fictional Form Fields
label: ch:pa-form-six-field-checkpoint
canDo: I can select six already taught fictional values from familiar nonverbal cues, write a six-line Gurmukhi form without a visible answer model, and repair selection, spelling, spacing, digit order, and placement separately.

payoff.summary: The learner fills name, language, residence, work, age, and phone lines from remembered cues without romanization or copyable answers, then repairs one error dimension at a time.
